text:
Vikram P: Quick follow-up from the kv-eviction PMwe promised remediation items + tests. Need owners for: nightly regression gate, incident-driven promptset, CI cold-cache smoke, and a short 30m chaos rehearsal. Can we lock owners and target dates?
Anya D: I can own the nightly regression harness and the auto-ticketing gate. Plan: nightly 6m cold-cache run, compute eviction_rate + TTL drift. If eviction_rate > 0.02 for two consecutive runs -> create Jira ticket and ping #incidents. I can open the PR by Wed EOD.
Marcus L: Ill take the promptset curation. Ill extract 12 canonical prompts + 6 edge cases (truncation, hallucination, partial-response). Will include golden outputs and a tiny scorer script that emits pass/fail. ETA next Monday.
Priya S: Ill add the CI cold-cache smoke job that runs on merges to staging-routing. Short run (3-4m) that injects synthetic key churn and asserts eviction_rate < 0.025 and p95 latency < baseline*1.2. PR by tomorrow morning.
ops-bot: Reminder created: "kv-eviction rehearsal" on 2026-04-15 15:00 UTC. Assigned: Anya D, Marcus L, Priya S.
evals-bot: Note: promptset should include expected scoring thresholds and mark which prompts are safety/critical. Upload results as artifact to evals-run.
Vikram P: Good. Also propose an automated daily sanity check: run a 5m load with 50k keys, assert eviction_rate < 0.02 and TTL_variation < 0.01. If it fails once, notify owners; if it fails twice consecutively, escalate to oncall.
Anya D: Agree. Ill wire the metric check into the nightly job and hook a small lambda to create the Jira ticket with run artifacts.
Marcus L: For promptset scoring: critical prompts = exact-match, tolerant prompts = fuzzy match (Jaccard > 0.7). Ill include examples of the truncation/hallucination cases and the expected pass/fail notes.
Priya S: CI snippet Ill add to infra/.github/workflows/kv_smoke.yaml:
```yaml
jobs:
  kv_cold_smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Run short cold-cache workload
        run: ./tests/run_kv_smoke.sh --keys 50000 --duration 240
      - name: Check eviction metric
        run: ./tools/check_metric.sh kv.cache.eviction_rate --threshold 0.025 || exit 2
      - name: Upload metrics
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: eviction-artifact
          path: metrics/evict.json
```
QA-bot: Reminder: tag runs with env=staging-inference and metrics_namespace=kv.cache. Include environment and commit SHA in artifacts.
Vikram P: Action summary (please confirm):
- Anya: nightly regression + gate + auto-ticket (PR Wed EOD)
- Marcus: promptset + scorer + docs (PR Mon)
- Priya: CI cold-cache smoke + artifact upload (PR tomorrow)
- Vikram: update staging rollout to ensure automatic routing fallback and a fast rollback trigger enabled
Please paste PR links here. We'll run a 20-min pre-drill validation once PRs merge.
Anya D: Confirmed. If gate fires well auto-create a ticket and include logs/artifacts.
Marcus L: Confirmed. Ill mark which prompts are critical and include playback examples for the drill.
Priya S: PR will be up by 09:00 UTC tomorrow and Ill paste link. Spiking now.
Vikram P: Thanks. If anything slips, call it out in-thread and well adjust the rehearsal window. :white_check_mark:
